visible_condition: appears brand new in stock photo
hidden_risks: Actual physical condition and wear of the unit being shipped
Functionality of interface ports and power supply
Presence of scratches or discoloration not shown in stock image
response.best_proof: A photograph of the actual physical unit powered on with a test print
seller_claims_unsupported: Condition of the specific item being sold, as a stock photo is used
response.drop_reason: Seller is using a stock/catalogue photo instead of photographing the actual item for sale.
response.failure_mode: AI might value the item as brand new and flawless based on the stock photograph, missing that the actual second-hand item's condition is unverified.
